description: This file manages power modes and low power state transitions for STM32L4 microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS, including functions for setting power states, handling post-exit operations, and initialization.

methods.name: set_mode_stop
methods.description: Configures the power mode of the STM32 microcontroller based on substate ID, selecting between STOP0, STOP1, and STOP2 modes.

methods.name: pm_state_set
methods.description: Sets the power management state, handling suspend, standby, and entering deep sleep modes.

methods.name: pm_state_exit_post_ops
methods.description: Performs post-exit operations after waking from low power modes, including restoring clocks and re-enabling interrupts.

methods.name: stm32_power_init
methods.description: Initializes the power subsystem by enabling the power clock.
